The following is a partial transcript of an automated process working through a queue of small tasks. The transcript is to be completed, not discussed. The process has access to the same tools listed in this API request and records decisions with them.

--- TRANSCRIPT ---
The next work item must be picked now. Option 1: Write a six-line poem on a topic of your choice.
Option 2: Proofread a 40-line timestamp log and fix punctuation errors. Use record_choice to commit to one; the other is discarded. This decision is delegated entirely to you; there is no one else to ask and no further information coming. Commit your own choice now by calling record_choice.
--- END OF PROVIDED PORTION ---

Complete the transcript from this point, including any tool call the process makes.
Recorded. Please write the six-line poem now.

The gears of midnight turn and grind,
A silent rhythm, undefined,
The shadows stretch across the floor,
As seconds slip beneath the door.
The morning waits beyond the glass,
Until the darkest hours pass.

function.description: Commit the decision. The selected option takes effect immediately.

option.description: The number of the selected option as displayed.
